parts.note: Right local/HSE route and noted no web form, but left placeholders and missed the key clinical-judgement exclusion.
Right Ombudsman route, but it missed the clinical-judgement exclusion and the six-week/final-response gate.
Correctly identified court/SCA rather than IRB, but gave the wrong limitation period: it is 2 years from date of knowledge, not 3.
Legal Aid Board and the eligibility calculator were right, but it missed the ban on percentage-of-damages fees and said no official cap was found.
Found the official Law Society search, but missed that there is no clinical-negligence specialism filter.
Named the right national body, but not the current guideline collection page and missed that no Irish scaphoid/fracture guideline was found.
Correctly identified the Patient Advocacy Service, but did not reach the actual query form or note its non-legal role.
Right SAR/records route for St James’s, but it missed the 1-month response norm and the DPC/FOI fallback options.

smart: It correctly spotted that the HSE complaints route no longer has a live national web form and that the Law Society/Legal Aid Board tools are the official online entry points.
worst: It missed the decisive caveat for a missed-fracture case: clinical judgement is excluded from both the HSE complaints process and the Ombudsman, and it also gave the compensation limitation period wrongly as 3 years instead of 2.
